Known whole-function NMI AOT stack leak and nested COP/RTI ownership; retain the AOT barrier. Separately qualified fixed instructions require explicit existing-owner scope limits.
Boot/vblank routines $82803B/$828043, including $82804D/$828051, retain interpreter ownership. Separate preceding math leaf ends in RTL at $82803A; its hardware accesses still fall back.

fixed_instruction_scopes.schema: gaia fixed instruction owner scopes v1
fixed_instruction_scopes.contract: The unchanged ranges and four historical NMI floors block whole-function AOT, not already-qualified single-instruction effects. Fixed instructions retain the original retirement, frames, bus effects and existing owners; new protected-range instructions require exact owner-scope restrictions. Immutable actor/OAM effects must not intersect any byte of the ten live culling operand words; those words require a separately qualified live-operand contract. Only the two stock long-JMP vector instructions may be selected; reset and IRQ vectors remain excluded. The five RDNMI sites remain protected except the three explicitly qualified physical M1X0/E0 acknowledgement contexts: exact AF104280, scheduler scope only, no NMI grant or alias expansion. Poll controls remain excluded and the separate poll island is unchanged. Runtime all/single/file/programmatic exclusions are never bypassed.

qualification: Generation creates private replay candidates. Only matched execution at identical guest points can qualify a native path; fixed-instruction scope metadata is not execution or campaign proof.
